problem: Given that $X∼\text{Geom}(0.23),$ compute $P(3<X<7)$ rounded to $4$ decimal places.

feedback.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(\frac{3}{8}),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}{(\frac{5}{8})}^{x-1}(\frac{3}{8}), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(2<X<7) & =P(X\in {3,4,5,6}) \\  & =P(X=3)+P(X=4)+P(X=5)+P(X=6) \\  & =f(3)+f(4)+f(5)+f(6) \\  & ={(\frac{5}{8})}^{2}(\frac{3}{8})+{(\frac{5}{8})}^{3}(\frac{3}{8})+{(\frac{5}{8})}^{4}(\frac{3}{8})+{(\frac{5}{8})}^{5}(\frac{3}{8}) \\  & ≈0.3310.\end{aligned}
$$
